item.title: Hundreds of WA National Guard members help flooded communities
item.description: National Guard members in Washington remain on the ground to assist with thousands of sand bags, door-to-door evacuations, traffic control, and rescue operations ahead more flooding this week.

item.title: WA flooding leaves Stevens Pass ski areas bare
item.description: Washington skiers will have to wait a little longer to hit the slopes as resorts see large areas of their snow pack wiped clean by atmospheric rivers.

item.title: WA officials shut down 6-mile stretch of SR-167 due to standing water
item.description: Several miles of highway are shut down with no estimated time of reopening between Kent and Auburn as elevated rivers continue to impact infrastructure across western Washington.

item.title: Second round of stormy weather ahead for Seattle this week
item.description: We're tracking prolonged and renewed river flooding ahead for Seattle and western Washington this week. There will be rounds of rain and wind.

item.title: Lummi Nation declares state of emergency as floods devastate parts of WA
item.description: Drone video from the Nooksack River at Slater Road shows a field of water. The flooding heavily impacts Lummi Nation, as there is now only one access point onto the land.

item.title: Pedestrian killed in hit-and-run crash in Kent, WA
item.description: A man is dead following a late night crash on Saturday in the Kent area. The driver who hit the victim fled the scene.

item.title: Jason Myers converts team record six field goals as Seattle Seahawks survive Colts 18-16
item.description: Jason Myers kicked a franchise-record six field goals, including a 56-yarder with 29 seconds left, and the Seattle Seahawks outlasted 44-year-old Philip Rivers and the Indianapolis Colts 18-16.

item.title: Seattle Weather: A Second Atmospheric River Arrives
item.description: The snowpack took a HUGE hit during last week’s atmospheric river event. A return to a more normal pattern this week will lead to chances of mountain snow with lowland rain.

item.title: Takeaways from Seattle Seahawks 18-16 win over Colts
item.description: The most prolific kicker in franchise history helped save the Seattle Seahawks from losing to a 44-year-old quarterback in Philip Rivers, who had been retired for five years.

item.title: Seattle Kraken slide continues in 3-1 loss to Sabres
item.description: Noah Ostlund, Tage Thompson and Zach Benson all scored and the Buffalo Sabres beat the Seattle Kraken 3-1 on Sunday.
